WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_activity" monthly_member_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)

青禾2026年7月和8月按完整自然月、全门店口径分别统计如下（统计单位为CRM会员账户）：

- 2026年7月：月内购买会员数11个账户，月内复购会员数1个账户，月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数=0.0909（约0.091）。
- 2026年8月：月内购买会员数15个账户，月内复购会员数12个账户，月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数=0.8。

口径说明：月内购买会员数指同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数指同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数；复购率分母为零时未定义。多月结果按月分别展示，不能将各月去重会员数相加当作跨月人数。
question: 青禾2026年7月和8月，每个月的购买会员数、复购会员数和复购率分别是多少？
